# Wavelike for OpenCode

Sign in to OpenCode with your company account and use the models your organization offers through Wavelike. Your access refreshes on its own, and usage counts against your own allowance.

Requires OpenCode 2 or later.

## Install

```bash
opencode plugin add @wavelike/opencode-plugin
```

## Sign in

```bash
opencode auth login
```

Choose **Wavelike**, then a sign-in method:

- **Wavelike Connect (device code)**: shows a one-time code to approve in your browser. Works on remote machines.
- **Wavelike Connect (browser)**: opens your company sign-in directly. On a remote machine, turn on the paste option and paste the final redirect URL back.

Enter your company domain, such as `yourcompany.com`. Leave the client ID blank: the plugin looks it up from the domain. If your admin gave you a Connect client ID instead, enter that.

Your organization's models appear as `wavelike/<stack-id>`.

## Settings

| Environment variable | Use |
| --- | --- |
| `WAVELIKE_COMPANY_DOMAIN` | Prefills the company domain |
| `WAVELIKE_CONNECT_CLIENT_ID` | Uses this client and skips the domain lookup |
| `WAVELIKE_ACCESS_PROFILE_ID` | Asks for a specific access profile |

The Wavelike API URL defaults to `https://api.wavelike.ai`.

## Help

If sign-in says your domain isn't set up, ask your Wavelike admin to verify the domain and choose the app for engineer tools. Full setup for every tool: https://wavelike.ai/docs/engineer-setup
